verdict.rationale: Steel documents hosted cloud browser sessions (Sessions API) and page tools (markdown, screenshots, PDFs). But the agent still drives the browser itself through CDP, the CLI or framework integrations. Nothing in the pack shows an endpoint that accepts a browser task and returns the result by polling or webhook. These are developer building blocks for building such a flow, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can submit a browser task over a hosted HTTP API and receive the result by polling or webhook, without managing any browser myself
